description: Searches Prim's catalogue of Argentine streaming by name: channels, programmes, people (hosts, streamers, guests) and upcoming events, each with the canonical url of its page on prim.profblu.com. Use it when you only have a name; then get_channel or get_person for the full page. Answers in the language requested with lang (es, en, it).

lang.description: Language of the answer: es (Spanish), en (English) or it (Italian). Defaults to es. Use the language the user writes in.

limit.description: How many results of each kind, 1 to 10. Defaults to 5.

query.description: What to look for, e.g. «Olga», «Nadie dice nada», «Migue Granados».

name: search

date.description: Date in Buenos Aires time, YYYY-MM-DD: the one prim.profblu.com shows

localTime.description: Start time at the venue's own time zone, HH:MM

time.description: Start time in Buenos Aires time, HH:MM: the one prim.profblu.com shows

url.description: Canonical page of the event on prim.profblu.com: cite it

suggestions.description: Only when what was asked for is not in Prim (or matches several): up to 3 similar names, to ask the user «did you mean…?». Nothing is claimed about them.

title: Search Prim
